'
      };

      const CURATED_12 = [
        {file:'4J9A3562.jpg',category:'exterior',title:'The Establishing Frame',role:'Proposed exterior hero · inspect original after import',preview:V.studio},
        {file:'4J9A3565.jpg',category:'exterior',title:'Front Hardware Detail',role:'Proposed close-up treatment · inspect original',preview:V.hitch},
        {file:'4J9A3569.jpg',category:'exterior',title:'Rear Profile',role:'Proposed rear angle · inspect original',preview:V.rear},
        {file:'4J9A3570.jpg',category:'interior',title:'A Sense of Space',role:'Proposed interior photograph · inspect original',preview:V.galley},
        {file:'4J9A3573.jpg',category:'detail',title:'Wheels & Underbody',role:'Proposed hardware/detail photograph · inspect original',preview:V.chassis},
        {file:'4J9A3580.jpg',category:'interior',title:'Interiors With Intention',role:'Proposed cabin composition · inspect original',preview:V.bedroom},
        {file:'4J9A3581.jpg',category:'interior',title:'Joinery & Finish',role:'Proposed crafted detail · inspect original',preview:V.galley},
        {file:'4J9A3595.jpg',category:'interior',title:'Bathroom Detail',role:'Proposed ensuite composition · inspect original',preview:V.ensuite},
        {file:'4J9A3603.jpg',category:'detail',title:'Services & Storage',role:'Proposed feature close-up · inspect original',preview:V.lithium},
        {file:'4J9A3607.jpg',category:'detail',title:'Outdoor Living',role:'Proposed utility scene · inspect original',preview:V.extkitch},
        {file:'DJI_0881.jpg',category:'aerial',title:'The Aerial Perspective',role:'Proposed high viewpoint · inspect original',preview:V.aerial},
        {file:'Photo 06-11-26, 21 38 05.jpg',category:'aerial',title:'A Sense of Place',role:'Proposed location frame · inspect original',preview:V.campaign}
      ];

      const localMediaMap = new Map();
      let activeFilter = 'curated';
      let currentFilteredList = [];
      let lightboxIndex = 0;

      const toastEl = document.getElementById('toast');
      let toastTimer = null;
      function showToast(msg) {
        toastEl.textContent = msg;
        toastEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        clearTimeout(toastTimer);
        toastTimer = setTimeout(() => toastEl.classList.add('hidden'), 3600);
      }

      // =========================================================================
      // 1. CINEMATIC 6-BEAT DISASSEMBLY WITH SVG CALLOUTS & MACRO LOUPES
      // =========================================================================
      const BEATS = [
        { id:'01', name:'The whole vehicle', title:'Form Before Detail', desc:'See the complete silhouette as a visual starting point. This demonstration uses conceptual artwork; final campaign assets should come from Ankkush’s approved originals.', shotRef:'Illustrative Exterior · concept only', badge:'Stage 01 · Whole Vehicle', progress:0, svgCallout:null, loupe:null },
        { id:'02', name:'Roof rises', title:'Reveal the Roofline', desc:'The roof illustration separates from the body. A production version can replace this with an approved animation and a genuine aerial photograph captured on the shoot.', shotRef:'Storyboard · Roof / Aerial', badge:'Stage 02 · Separate Roof Layer', progress:.22, svgCallout:'svg-call-roof', loupe:null },
        { id:'03', name:'Cabin exposed', title:'Open Up the Interior', desc:'Side and cabin layers move independently, then the story should hand off to real interior photography selected from the manufacturer’s approved gallery.', shotRef:'Storyboard · Interior / Joinery', badge:'Stage 03 · Independent Side Layers', progress:.44, svgCallout:'svg-call-cabin', loupe:{src:V.galley,caption:'Illustrative interior concept · not verified work'} },
        { id:'04', name:'Front separates', title:'The Front End in Focus', desc:'The nose section moves forward as a separate visual element. Real product photography can later show front storage, the coupling and relevant details without inventing specifications.', shotRef:'Storyboard · Front Details', badge:'Stage 04 · Nose Moves Forward', progress:.64, svgCallout:'svg-call-nose', loupe:{src:V.hitch,caption:'Illustrative front-end concept · not verified work'} },
        { id:'05', name:'Chassis appears', title:'From Bodywork to Stance', desc:'The lower assembly is isolated to show how a reveal can direct attention to underbody photography. This is an artistic illustration, not a true mechanical teardown.', shotRef:'Storyboard · Chassis / Wheels', badge:'Stage 05 · Lower Assembly', progress:.82, svgCallout:'svg-call-chassis', loupe:{src:V.chassis,caption:'Illustrative chassis concept · not verified work'} },
        { id:'06', name:'To the real work', title:'From Spectacle to Proof', desc:'Reassemble the concept and move into Ankkush’s actual Billabong images and finished films once the genuine Dropbox media has been imported and publication authorised.', shotRef:'Handoff · Approved Project Media', badge:'Stage 06 · Portfolio Handoff', progress:1, svgCallout:null, loupe:null }
      ];

      const plateAssembled = document.getElementById('plate-assembled');
      const plateCutaway = document.getElementById('plate-cutaway');
      const plateExploded = document.getElementById('plate-exploded');
      const plateCampaign = document.getElementById('plate-campaign');
      const assemblyParts = document.getElementById('assembly-parts');
      const pieceTransforms = [
        ['piece-roof',   0, -25,  0, -1.2],
        ['piece-nose', -21,  -3, -1.6,  0],
        ['piece-cabin', -5,   5,  0,    .6],
        ['piece-wall',  15,   0,  1.4,  0],
        ['piece-chassis',0,  19,  0,   1]
      ];
      const pieceElements = pieceTransforms.map(([id])=>document.getElementById(id));
      const hotspotLayer = document.getElementById('hotspot-layer');
      const stageBadge = document.getElementById('stage-mode-badge');
      const detailLoupe = document.getElementById('detail-loupe');
      const loupeImg = document.getElementById('loupe-img');
      const loupeCaption = document.getElementById('loupe-caption');

      const beatNavList = document.getElementById('beat-nav-list');
      const beatIndexEl = document.getElementById('beat-index');
      const beatPctEl = document.getElementById('beat-progress-pct');
      const beatTitleEl = document.getElementById('beat-title');
      const beatDescEl = document.getElementById('beat-desc');
      const beatShotEl = document.getElementById('beat-shot-ref');
      const scrubberEl = document.getElementById('disassembly-scrubber');

      let targetProgress = 0, smoothProgress = 0, manualScrubLock = false, isXrayMode = false;

      BEATS.forEach((b, i) => {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.className = 'beat-jump-btn w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border border-sand bg-alabaster text-umber hover:text-espresso hover:border-bronze transition-colors flex items-center justify-between';
        btn.innerHTML = '<span>' + b.id + ' · ' + b.name + '</span><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-sand beat-dot"></span>';
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => jumpToBeat(i));
        beatNavList.appendChild(btn);
      });

      function clamp01(v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); }
      function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
      function getBeatForProgress(p) {
        if (p < 0.15) return 0;
        if (p < 0.34) return 1;
        if (p < 0.54) return 2;
        if (p < 0.74) return 3;
        if (p < 0.90) return 4;
        return 5;
      }

      function applyExplodeVisuals(p) {
        if (isXrayMode) return;
        const oCutaway = clamp01((p - 0.11) / 0.13);
        const oExploded = clamp01((p - 0.29) / 0.13);
        const oCampaign = clamp01((p - 0.87) / 0.11);

        plateAssembled.style.opacity = String(1 - oCutaway * 0.92);
        plateAssembled.style.transform = `scale(${lerp(1.0, 1.045, clamp01(p / 0.2)).toFixed(4)})`;
        plateCutaway.style.opacity = String(oCutaway * (1 - oExploded));
        plateCutaway.style.transform = `scale(${lerp(1.035, 1.0, oCutaway).toFixed(4)})`;

        let exScale = 1.0, exX = 0, exY = 0;
        if (p >= 0.34 && p < 0.56) {
          const t = clamp01((p - 0.35) / 0.19);
          exScale = lerp(1.0, 1.075, t); exX = lerp(0, 1.8, t); exY = lerp(0, 1.2, t);
        } else if (p >= 0.56 && p < 0.74) {
          const t = clamp01((p - 0.56) / 0.16);
          exScale = lerp(1.075, 1.095, t); exX = lerp(1.8, 4.2, t); exY = lerp(1.2, -1.0, t);
        } else if (p >= 0.74 && p < 0.90) {
          const t = clamp01((p - 0.74) / 0.14);
          exScale = lerp(1.095, 1.08, t); exX = lerp(4.2, -2.5, t); exY = lerp(-1.0, -4.0, t);
        }

        // Progressively articulate five separate masked components from the same illustrative image.
        // This is image-layer choreography, deliberately NOT labelled as a manufacturer CAD exploded view.
        const componentShow = clamp01((p - .30) / .10) * (1 - clamp01((p - .87) / .10));
        assemblyParts.style.opacity = String(componentShow);
        const opening = clamp01((p - .34) / .34);
        const closing = clamp01((p - .77) / .15);
        const separation = opening * (1 - closing);
        pieceTransforms.forEach(([id,x,y,rotation,z],i)=>{
          const el=pieceElements[i];
          if(!el)return;
          el.style.transform = `translate(${(x*separation).toFixed(2)}%, ${(y*separation).toFixed(2)}%) rotate(${(rotation*separation).toFixed(2)}deg) scale(${(1+(z*.018*separation)).toFixed(3)})`;
        });
        // Keep full exploded plate as a brief visual bridge only; individual layers carry the motion.
        plateExploded.style.opacity = String(oExploded * (1 - clamp01((p-.35)/.08)) * (1-oCampaign));
        plateExploded.style.transform = `scale(${exScale.toFixed(4)}) translate(${exX.toFixed(2)}%, ${exY.toFixed(2)}%)`;
        plateCampaign.style.opacity = String(oCampaign);
        plateCampaign.style.transform = `scale(${lerp(1.045, 1.0, oCampaign).toFixed(4)})`;

        const showHotspots = p >= 0.36 && p <= 0.86;
        hotspotLayer.style.opacity = showHotspots ? '1' : '0';
        hotspotLayer.style.pointerEvents = showHotspots ? 'auto' : 'none';
      }

      function updateBeatUI(p) {
        const idx = getBeatForProgress(p);
        const b = BEATS[idx];
        beatIndexEl.textContent = 'BEAT ' + b.id + ' / 06';
        beatPctEl.textContent = Math.round(p * 100) + '%';
        beatTitleEl.textContent = b.title;
        beatDescEl.textContent = b.desc;
        beatShotEl.textContent = b.shotRef;
        if (!isXrayMode) stageBadge.textContent = b.badge;
        if (!manualScrubLock) scrubberEl.value = (p * 100).toFixed(1);

        // Toggle precision SVG callout leader lines
        ['svg-call-roof', 'svg-call-cabin', 'svg-call-nose', 'svg-call-chassis'].forEach(id => {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.style.opacity = (!isXrayMode && b.svgCallout === id) ? '1' : '0';
        });

        if (b.loupe && !isXrayMode) {
          loupeImg.src = b.loupe.src;
          loupeCaption.textContent = b.loupe.caption;
          detailLoupe.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-2');
          detailLoupe.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
        } else {
          detailLoupe.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-2');
          detailLoupe.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.beat-jump-btn').forEach((btn, i) => {
          const dot = btn.querySelector('.beat-dot');
          if (i === idx) {
            btn.classList.add('border-bronze', 'bg-ivory', 'text-espresso', 'font-medium');
            btn.classList.remove('border-sand', 'bg-alabaster', 'text-umber');
            if (dot) { dot.classList.add('bg-bronze'); dot.classList.remove('bg-sand'); }
          } else {
            btn.classList.remove('border-bronze', 'bg-ivory', 'text-espresso', 'font-medium');
            btn.classList.add('border-sand', 'bg-alabaster', 'text-umber');
            if (dot) { dot.classList.remove('bg-bronze'); dot.classList.add('bg-sand'); }
          }
        });
      }

      function jumpToBeat(idx) {
        setXrayMode(false);
        const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(BEATS.length - 1, idx));
        const p = BEATS[clamped].progress;
        manualScrubLock = false;
        targetProgress = p;
        scrubberEl.value = (p * 100).toFixed(1);
        updateBeatUI(p);
        const track = document.getElementById('disassembly-track');
        const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 768 && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
        if (isDesktop && track) {
          const trackTop = track.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
          const scrollable = track.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
          window.scrollTo({ top: trackTop + scrollable * p, behavior: 'smooth' });
        } else {
          targetProgress = p;
          scrubberEl.value = (p * 100).toFixed(1);
          updateBeatUI(p);
        }
      }

      const HOTSPOT_MAP = { roof: 1, cabin: 2, nose: 3, chassis: 4 };
      document.querySelectorAll('.hotspot-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const targetIdx = HOTSPOT_MAP[btn.dataset.hotspot];
          if (typeof targetIdx === 'number') {
            targetProgress = BEATS[targetIdx].progress;
            updateBeatUI(targetProgress);
            showToast('Focused: ' + BEATS[targetIdx].title);
          }
        });
      });

      const modeScrollBtn = document.getElementById('mode-scroll-btn');
      const modeXrayBtn = document.getElementById('mode-xray-btn');
      const xrayOverlay = document.getElementById('xray-overlay');
      const xrayDivider = document.getElementById('xray-divider');
      const xrayRange = document.getElementById('xray-range');

      function setXrayMode(enabled) {
        isXrayMode = enabled;
        xrayOverlay.classList.toggle('hidden', !enabled);
        xrayDivider.classList.toggle('hidden', !enabled);
        xrayRange.classList.toggle('hidden', !enabled);
        if (enabled) {
          modeXrayBtn.classList.add('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory');
          modeXrayBtn.classList.remove('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-espresso');
          modeScrollBtn.classList.remove('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory');
          modeScrollBtn.classList.add('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-espresso');
          assemblyParts.style.opacity = '0';
          plateAssembled.style.opacity = '1'; plateAssembled.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
          plateCutaway.style.opacity = '0'; plateExploded.style.opacity = '0'; plateCampaign.style.opacity = '0';
          hotspotLayer.style.opacity = '0'; detailLoupe.classList.add('opacity-0');
          ['svg-call-roof', 'svg-call-cabin', 'svg-call-nose', 'svg-call-chassis'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.style.opacity = '0';
          });
          stageBadge.textContent = 'X-Ray Wipe · Drag Left or Right to Peel Exterior';
        } else {
          modeScrollBtn.classList.add('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory');
          modeScrollBtn.classList.remove('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-espresso');
          modeXrayBtn.classList.remove('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory');
          modeXrayBtn.classList.add('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-espresso');
          applyExplodeVisuals(smoothProgress);
          updateBeatUI(smoothProgress);
        }
      }

      modeScrollBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setXrayMode(false));
      modeXrayBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setXrayMode(true));
      xrayRange.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        const val = parseFloat(e.target.value);
        xrayOverlay.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${100 - val}% 0 0)`;
        xrayDivider.style.left = val + '%';
      });

      document.getElementById('beat-prev-btn').addEventListener('click', () => jumpToBeat(getBeatForProgress(targetProgress) - 1));
      document.getElementById('beat-next-btn').addEventListener('click', () => jumpToBeat(getBeatForProgress(targetProgress) + 1));
      scrubberEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => { const scrubbed = parseFloat(e.target.value) / 100; setXrayMode(false); manualScrubLock = true; targetProgress = clamp01(scrubbed); updateBeatUI(targetProgress); });
      scrubberEl.addEventListener('change', () => { manualScrubLock = false; });

      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        const isDesktop = window.innerWidth >= 768 && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
        if (!isDesktop || manualScrubLock || isXrayMode) return;
        const track = document.getElementById('disassembly-track');
        if (!track) return;
        const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scrollable = track.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight;
        if (scrollable <= 0) return;
        const clamped = clamp01(-rect.top / scrollable);
        targetProgress = clamped;
        updateBeatUI(clamped);
      }, { passive: true });

      function animationLoop() {
        smoothProgress += (targetProgress - smoothProgress) * 0.085;
        applyExplodeVisuals(smoothProgress);
        requestAnimationFrame(animationLoop);
      }

      // =========================================================================
      // 2. QUIET-LUXURY PACKAGES & DYNAMIC SCOPE YIELD CONFIGURATOR
      // =========================================================================
      let selectedPackage = 'Flagship Model Launch (Stills + Film)';
      let baseStills = 40, baseReels = 4, modelCount = 1, shootEnv = 'Factory Bay / Yard';
      const selectedAddons = new Set();

      function updateScopeYield() {
        document.getElementById('scope-model-val').textContent = String(modelCount);
        const totalStills = baseStills * modelCount + (selectedAddons.has('CASA Aerial Drone') ? 8 * modelCount : 0);
        const totalReels = baseReels + (selectedAddons.has('6x Paid Social 9:16 Reels') ? 6 : 0);
        const filmNote = selectedPackage.includes('Dealer') ? 'Walkarounds' : 'Cuts + Film';
        document.getElementById('selected-scope-summary').textContent = selectedPackage.split(' (')[0];
        document.getElementById('yield-stills').textContent = '~' + totalStills + ' Frames';
        document.getElementById('yield-reels').textContent = totalReels + ' ' + filmNote;
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
          selectedPackage = card.dataset.pkg;
          baseStills = parseInt(card.dataset.baseStills || '30', 10);
          baseReels = parseInt(card.dataset.baseReels || '4', 10);
          document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card').forEach((c, idx) => {
            const isSel = c === card;
            c.classList.toggle('border-2', isSel);
            c.classList.toggle('border-bronze', isSel);
            c.classList.toggle('shadow-sm', isSel);
            c.classList.toggle('hairline-all', !isSel);
            const btn = c.querySelector('.pkg-select-btn');
            if (btn) {
              btn.classList.toggle('bg-espresso', isSel);
              btn.classList.toggle('text-ivory', isSel);
              btn.classList.toggle('border', !isSel);
              btn.classList.toggle('border-sand', !isSel);
              btn.classList.toggle('bg-alabaster', !isSel);
              btn.classList.toggle('text-espresso', !isSel);
              btn.textContent = isSel ? 'Selected · Tier 0' + (idx + 1) : 'Select Tier 0' + (idx + 1);
            }
          });
          updateScopeYield();
        });
      });

      document.getElementById('scope-model-dec').addEventListener('click', () => { modelCount = Math.max(1, modelCount - 1); updateScopeYield(); });
      document.getElementById('scope-model-inc').addEventListener('click', () => { modelCount = Math.min(12, modelCount + 1); updateScopeYield(); });

      document.querySelectorAll('.env-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          shootEnv = btn.dataset.env;
          document.querySelectorAll('.env-btn').forEach(b => {
            const m = b === btn;
            b.classList.toggle('border-bronze', m);
            b.classList.toggle('bg-alabaster', m);
            b.classList.toggle('text-espresso', m);
            b.classList.toggle('border-sand', !m);
            b.classList.toggle('bg-ivory', !m);
            b.classList.toggle('text-umber', !m);
          });
        });
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.addon-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const addon = btn.dataset.addon;
          if (selectedAddons.has(addon)) {
            selectedAddons.delete(addon);
            btn.classList.remove('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory', 'border-espresso');
            btn.classList.add('bg-alabaster', 'text-espresso', 'border-sand');
          } else {
            selectedAddons.add(addon);
            btn.classList.add('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory', 'border-espresso');
            btn.classList.remove('bg-alabaster', 'text-espresso', 'border-sand');
          }
          updateScopeYield();
        });
      });

      document.getElementById('prefill-brief-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const shootSelect = document.getElementById('f-shoot-type');
        const modelsInput = document.getElementById('f-models');
        const notesField = document.getElementById('f-notes');
        if (shootSelect) shootSelect.value = selectedPackage;
        if (modelsInput) modelsInput.value = String(modelCount);
        const addonsList = selectedAddons.size > 0 ? '\nEnrichments: ' + Array.from(selectedAddons).join(', ') : '';
        notesField.value = 'Package: ' + selectedPackage + '\nEnvironment: ' + shootEnv + '\nModels: ' + modelCount + addonsList + '\nAdditional notes: ';
        document.getElementById('enquiry').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        showToast('Scope transferred to your production brief.');
      });

      // =========================================================================
      // 3. PLAYABLE MOTION REELS
      // =========================================================================
      function createCinemaReel(canvasId, btnId, timeId, slides) {
        const c = document.getElementById(canvasId);
        const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
        const timeEl = document.getElementById(timeId);
        if (!c || !btn) return;
        const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
        const imgs = slides.map(s => { const im = new Image(); im.src = s.src; return { im, label: s.label }; });
        let playing = false, elapsed = 0, lastTs = 0;
        const totalDur = 20;

        function resizeCanvas() {
          const rect = c.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
          c.width = Math.max(640, Math.round(rect.width * Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2)));
          c.height = Math.max(360, Math.round(rect.height * Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2)));
        }

        function drawFrame(tSec) {
          if (!ctx) return;
          const w = c.width, h = c.height;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#EFE9DE';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
          const segDur = totalDur / imgs.length;
          const segIdx = Math.floor(tSec / segDur) % imgs.length;
          const nextIdx = (segIdx + 1) % imgs.length;
          const localT = (tSec % segDur) / segDur;

          function drawKB(entry, alpha, z0, z1, panX) {
            if (!entry.im.complete || entry.im.naturalWidth === 0) return;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
            const zoom = lerp(z0, z1, localT);
            const iw = entry.im.naturalWidth, ih = entry.im.naturalHeight;
            const scale = Math.max(w / iw, h / ih) * zoom;
            const dw = iw * scale, dh = ih * scale;
            ctx.drawImage(entry.im, (w - dw) / 2 + panX * localT * 28, (h - dh) / 2, dw, dh);
            ctx.restore();
          }

          drawKB(imgs[segIdx], 1, 1.02, 1.11, segIdx % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1);
          if (localT > 0.78) drawKB(imgs[nextIdx], (localT - 0.78) / 0.22, 1.0, 1.04, 0.5);

          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(252, 251, 248, 0.88)';
          ctx.fillRect(18, 18, 250, 28);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#9A6B38';
          ctx.font = '500 11px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
          ctx.fillText(imgs[segIdx].label.toUpperCase(), 28, 36);
          ctx.restore();

          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(154, 107, 56, 0.85)';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w * (tSec / totalDur), 3);
          if (timeEl) timeEl.textContent = '00:' + String(Math.floor(tSec)).padStart(2, '0') + ' / 00:20';
        }

        function tick(ts) {
          if (!lastTs) lastTs = ts;
          const dt = (ts - lastTs) / 1000;
          lastTs = ts;
          if (playing) elapsed = (elapsed + dt) % totalDur;
          drawFrame(elapsed);
          requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }

        btn.addEventListener('click', () => { playing = !playing; btn.textContent = playing ? 'Pause Concept' : 'Play Concept'; });
        resizeCanvas();
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
        imgs[0].im.onload = () => drawFrame(0);
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }

      // =========================================================================
      // 4. GALLERY, LIGHTBOX & DISCREET LOCAL MEDIA SWAP
      // =========================================================================
      const portfolioGrid = document.getElementById('portfolio-grid');

      function renderGallery() {
        currentFilteredList = activeFilter === 'curated' ? CURATED_12 : CURATED_12.filter(i => i.category === activeFilter);
        portfolioGrid.innerHTML = '';

        currentFilteredList.forEach((item, listIdx) => {
          const blobUrl = localMediaMap.get(item.file.toLowerCase());
          const imgSrc = blobUrl || item.preview;

          const card = document.createElement('button');
          card.type = 'button';
          card.className = 'group text-left bg-ivory hairline-all hover:border-bronze transition-colors overflow-hidden flex flex-col focus:outline-none';
          card.addEventListener('click', () => openLightbox(listIdx));
          card.innerHTML = `
            <div class="aspect-[16/10] w-full overflow-hidden bg-travertine">
              <img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${blobUrl ? 'Imported original: ' : 'Illustrative concept: '}${item.title}" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500" loading="lazy" />
            </div>
            <div class="gallery-provenance">${blobUrl ? 'IMPORTED FROM LOCAL DROPBOX FOLDER · PREVIEW ONLY' : 'ILLUSTRATIVE CONCEPT IMAGE · REPLACE BEFORE PUBLICATION'}</div>
            <div class="p-5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
              <span class="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-bronze">${item.category}</span>
              <h4 class="mt-1.5 font-editorial text-2xl text-espresso group-hover:text-bronze transition-colors">${item.title}</h4>
              <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-umber">${item.role}</p>
            </div>
          `;
          portfolioGrid.appendChild(card);
        });
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          activeFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
          document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.classList.remove('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory');
            b.classList.add('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-umber');
          });
          btn.classList.add('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory');
          btn.classList.remove('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-umber');
          renderGallery();
        });
      });

      const lightboxEl = document.getElementById('lightbox');
      const lbFilename = document.getElementById('lb-filename');
      const lbTitle = document.getElementById('lb-title');
      const lbStage = document.getElementById('lb-stage');
      const lbCaption = document.getElementById('lb-caption');
      const lbCounter = document.getElementById('lb-counter');

      function openLightbox(idx) { lightboxIndex = idx; renderLightboxItem(); lightboxEl.classList.remove('hidden'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
      function closeLightbox() { lightboxEl.classList.add('hidden'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
      function renderLightboxItem() {
        const item = currentFilteredList[lightboxIndex];
        if (!item) return;
        const blobUrl = localMediaMap.get(item.file.toLowerCase());
        const imgSrc = blobUrl || item.preview;
        lbFilename.textContent = item.category.toUpperCase();
        lbTitle.textContent = item.title;
        lbCaption.textContent = (blobUrl ? 'Imported original · ' : 'Illustrative concept · not verified work · ') + item.role;
        lbCounter.textContent = (lightboxIndex + 1) + ' / ' + currentFilteredList.length;
        lbStage.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${item.title}" class="max-h-[68vh] max-w-full object-contain hairline-all shadow-md" />`;
      }

      document.getElementById('lb-close').addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);
      document.getElementById('lb-prev').addEventListener('click', () => { lightboxIndex = (lightboxIndex - 1 + currentFilteredList.length) % currentFilteredList.length; renderLightboxItem(); });
      document.getElementById('lb-next').addEventListener('click', () => { lightboxIndex = (lightboxIndex + 1) % currentFilteredList.length; renderLightboxItem(); });
      window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (lightboxEl.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox();
        if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') document.getElementById('lb-prev').click();
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') document.getElementById('lb-next').click();
      });

      document.getElementById('footer-local-input').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        let count = 0;
        Array.from(e.target.files || []).forEach(file => {
          const lower = file.name.toLowerCase();
          if (lower === 'billabong caravans.mp4') {
            document.getElementById('video-slot-1').innerHTML = `<video src="${URL.createObjectURL(file)}" controls playsinline class="w-full h-full object-cover"></video>`;
            count++;
          } else if (lower === 'caravan 2.mp4') {
            document.getElementById('video-slot-2').innerHTML = `<video src="${URL.createObjectURL(file)}" controls playsinline class="w-full h-full object-cover"></video>`;
            count++;
          } else if (file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            localMediaMap.set(lower, url);
            if (lower === '4j9a3562.jpg') document.getElementById('hero-bg-img').src = url;
            count++;
          }
        });
        renderGallery();
        if (count > 0) showToast('Loaded ' + count + ' local media file(s) for preview.');
      });

      // =========================================================================
      // 5. CHANNEL MATRIX, NETLIFY-READY ENQUIRY & MOBILE NAV
      // =========================================================================
      const CHANNEL_TIERS = {
        launch: [
          { ch: 'Website Hero & Configurator', spec: '16:9 + 21:9 WebP', desc: 'Sunlit studio or golden-hour 3/4 exterior hero frames plus clean side and front elevations.' },
          { ch: 'Dealer Portal & Spec Sheets', spec: '30–40 Curated Stills', desc: 'True-vertical interiors, galley, ensuite, lithium power bays, and tunnel boot details.' },
          { ch: 'Print Brochure & Expo Walls', spec: '16-Bit Print Masters', desc: 'Retouched high-resolution spreads calibrated for Caravan & Camping Supershow walls.' },
          { ch: 'YouTube Launch Film', spec: '60–90s 4K Master', desc: 'Cinema-graded model launch film with sound design, rolling tow shots, and cabin reveal.' },
          { ch: 'Paid Meta & Google Ads', spec: '3 × 15s Cutdowns', desc: 'Hook-first performance variations isolating suspension, off-grid power, and interior luxury.' },
          { ch: 'Instagram Reels & TikTok', spec: '4–6 × 9:16 Verticals', desc: 'Native vertical framing captured on set—never awkwardly cropped from landscape footage.' }
        ],
        range: [
          { ch: 'Unified Range Consistency', spec: '3–6 Models / Same Light', desc: 'Matched colour temperature, camera height, and lens geometry across your entire line.' },
          { ch: 'Model Comparison Grids', spec: 'Standardised Elevations', desc: 'Consistent 3/4 front, rear, and floorplan interior views so buyers compare effortlessly.' },
          { ch: 'Showroom & Press Kits', spec: 'Print + Digital Pack', desc: 'Organised per-model folder hierarchy ready for national dealer networks.' },
          { ch: 'Range Sizzle Reel', spec: '90s Brand Film', desc: 'Cohesive manufacturer brand film uniting multiple models in one narrative arc.' },
          { ch: 'Dealer Co-Op Ad Pack', spec: 'Per-Model Ad Stills', desc: 'Pre-sized 1:1, 4:5, and 16:9 creatives ready for regional dealer ad accounts.' },
          { ch: 'Social Content Bank', spec: '30-Day Vertical Library', desc: 'Detail loops, cabinetry transitions, and walk-through clips for sustained reach.' }
        ],
        dealer: [
          { ch: 'Yard Inventory Listings', spec: '20+ Stills / Van', desc: 'Fast, clean exterior and interior sets tailored for CaravanCampingSales and dealer sites.' },
          { ch: 'Walkaround Reels', spec: '45s Vertical Tours', desc: 'Smooth gimbal cabin tours highlighting floorplan flow without shaky phone footage.' },
          { ch: 'Google Business & Local SEO', spec: 'Geo-Ready WebP Set', desc: 'Crisp showroom and stock imagery that lifts local Melbourne & regional buyer trust.' },
          { ch: 'Facebook Marketplace & Meta', spec: '4:5 Lead-Gen Carousels', desc: 'Scroll-stopping hero + 4 interior highlights structured for high-intent lead forms.' },
          { ch: 'Handover & Brand Trust', spec: 'Optional Yard B-Roll', desc: 'Workshop, pre-delivery inspection, and dealership credibility clips.' },
          { ch: 'Predictable Cadence', spec: 'Monthly / Quarterly', desc: 'Repeatable content days scheduled as new factory stock lands on your yard.' }
        ]
      };

      const channelMatrixEl = document.getElementById('channel-matrix');
      function renderChannelTier(tierKey) {
        const items = CHANNEL_TIERS[tierKey] || CHANNEL_TIERS.launch;
        channelMatrixEl.innerHTML = items.map((item, idx) => `
          <div class="p-6 bg-ivory hairline-all flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span class="font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-bronze">0${idx + 1}</span>
                <span class="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 bg-alabaster hairline-all text-umber">${item.spec}</span>
              </div>
              <h3 class="mt-3 font-editorial text-2xl text-espresso">${item.ch}</h3>
              <p class="mt-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-umber leading-relaxed">${item.desc}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('');
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('.tier-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          document.querySelectorAll('.tier-btn').forEach(b => { b.classList.remove('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory'); b.classList.add('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-umber'); });
          btn.classList.add('bg-espresso', 'text-ivory'); btn.classList.remove('border', 'border-sand', 'bg-ivory', 'text-umber');
          renderChannelTier(btn.dataset.tier);
        });
      });

      const form = document.getElementById('enquiry-form');
      const formError = document.getElementById('form-error');
      const briefPanel = document.getElementById('brief-ready-panel');
      const briefText = document.getElementById('brief-output-text');
      const mailtoLink = document.getElementById('brief-mailto-link');

      form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        formError.classList.add('hidden');
        const company = document.getElementById('f-company').value.trim();
        const name = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
        const email = document.getElementById('f-email').value.trim();
        const location = document.getElementById('f-location').value.trim();
        const shootType = document.getElementById('f-shoot-type').value;
        const models = document.getElementById('f-models').value;
        const timeframe = document.getElementById('f-timeframe').value;
        const notes = document.getElementById('f-notes').value.trim();
        const consent = document.getElementById('f-consent').checked;

        const errs = [];
        if (!company) errs.push('Company / Brand is required.');
        if (!name) errs.push('Your Name is required.');
        if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) errs.push('Please enter a valid work email.');
        if (!location) errs.push('Location / Suburb is required.');
        if (!shootType) errs.push('Please select a Production Package.');
        if (!notes) errs.push('Please include a brief project description.');
        if (!consent) errs.push('Please confirm consent to share your brief.');

        if (errs.length > 0) {
          formError.textContent = errs.join(' ');
          formError.classList.remove('hidden');
          briefPanel.classList.add('hidden');
          return;
        }

        const formatted = [
          'SIXTHVISION — CARAVAN & RV PRODUCTION BRIEF',
          '--------------------------------------------',
          'Company:    ' + company,
          'Contact:    ' + name + ' (' + email + ')',
          'Location:   ' + location,
          'Package:    ' + shootType,
          'Models:     ' + models,
          'Timeframe:  ' + timeframe,
          '',
          'Project Scope:',
          notes
        ].join('\n');

        briefText.textContent = formatted;
        // Do not publish an unapproved contact mailbox. Configure CONTACT_EMAIL before going live.
        const CONTACT_EMAIL = '';
        if (CONTACT_EMAIL) { mailtoLink.href = 'mailto:' + CONTACT_EMAIL + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent('Caravan Production Enquiry — ' + company) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(formatted); }
        else { mailtoLink.classList.add('hidden'); }

        // Submit cleanly via Netlify Forms when deployed on https:// (falls back honestly in local/sandbox preview)
        const isLiveHost = window.location.hostname.endsWith('.netlify.app');
        if (isLiveHost) {
          const fd = new FormData(form);
          fd.set('form-name', 'production-brief');
          fetch('/', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
            body: new URLSearchParams(fd).toString()
          }).then(res => {
            if (res.ok) {
              document.getElementById('brief-status-heading').textContent = 'Brief Submitted to SixthVision';
              document.getElementById('brief-status-sub').textContent = 'Submission confirmed by Netlify · Copy retained below';
              showToast('Production brief received by Netlify.');
            }
            else { formError.textContent = 'Submission was not confirmed. Copy the brief below and contact SixthVision directly.'; formError.classList.remove('hidden'); }
          }).catch(() => { formError.textContent = 'Network error. Your brief is ready to copy below; submission was not confirmed.'; formError.classList.remove('hidden'); });
        }

        briefPanel.classList.remove('hidden');
        briefPanel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        showToast('Production brief ready.');
      });

      document.getElementById('copy-brief-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const text = briefText.textContent;
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => showToast('Brief copied to clipboard.'));
        } else {
          const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
          ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta);
          showToast('Brief copied to clipboard.');
        }
      });

      const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-btn');
      const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
      mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const open = !mobileMenu.classList.contains('hidden');
        mobileMenu.classList.toggle('hidden', open);
        mobileMenuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!open));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', () => { mobileMenu.classList.add('hidden'); mobileMenuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }));

      // Build-time real media manifest, created by tools/ingest_dropbox.py.
      // No external account API or browser directory permission is required after deployment.
      async function hydrateBundledMedia(){
        try {
          const res = await fetch('./assets/real-media.json', {cache:'no-store'});
          if(!res.ok)return;
          const data=await res.json();
          let count=0;
          const files=data.images||{};
          for(const [name,url] of Object.entries(files)){
            if(typeof name==='string' && typeof url==='string' && url.startsWith('./assets/billabong/')){
              localMediaMap.set(name.toLowerCase(),url);count++;
            }
          }
          // Hero photo is explicit editorial selection only; never guess it from filename.
          if(data.hero && localMediaMap.has(String(data.hero).toLowerCase())){
            document.getElementById('hero-bg-img').src=localMediaMap.get(data.hero.toLowerCase());
            const label=document.querySelector('#top .relative.overflow-hidden .absolute.bottom-3');
            if(label)label.textContent='Imported source photography · publication rights must be confirmed';
          }
          const videos=data.videos||{};
          for(const [name,id] of [['Billabong caravans.mp4','video-slot-1'],['caravan 2.mp4','video-slot-2']]){
            const url=videos[name];
            if(typeof url==='string' && url.startsWith('./assets/billabong/')){
              const slot=document.getElementById(id);
              slot.replaceChildren();
              const video=document.createElement('video');
              video.src=url;video.controls=true;video.playsInline=true;video.preload='metadata';
              video.className='w-full h-full object-cover';
              slot.appendChild(video);count++;
            }
          }
          if(count){renderGallery();showToast(count+' source files loaded from site assets.');}
        }catch(e){console.info('Real portfolio asset manifest unavailable; retaining clearly labelled concept assets.');}
      }

      // INIT
      renderGallery();
      hydrateBundledMedia();
      renderChannelTier('launch');
      updateScopeYield();
      updateBeatUI(0);
      applyExplodeVisuals(0);
      requestAnimationFrame(animationLoop);

      createCinemaReel('reel-canvas-1', 'reel-play-1', 'reel-time-1', [
        { src: V.campaign, label: '01 · Grampians Golden Hour' },
        { src: V.extkitch, label: '02 · External Camp Kitchen' },
        { src: V.galley,   label: '03 · Tasmanian Oak Galley' },
        { src: V.bedroom,  label: '04 · Linen Master Bedroom' },
        { src: V.aerial,   label: '05 · Coastal Aerial Scale' }
      ]);
      createCinemaReel('reel-canvas-2', 'reel-play-2', 'reel-time-2', [
        { src: V.studio,   label: '01 · Limestone Studio Hero' },
        { src: V.exploded, label: '02 · Full Exploded Build' },
        { src: V.lithium,  label: '03 · Off-Grid Lithium Bay' },
        { src: V.chassis,  label: '04 · Twin-Shock Suspension' },
        { src: V.rear,     label: '05 · Rear Departure Stance' }
      ]);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
